basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old art teacher living in Austin, Texas. I recently picked up a Nintendo Switch and dove into the world of Animal Crossing after hearing so much about it from my students. My interests include gaming, animation, and exploring new music genres. I'm also a big fan of anime, with Zombieland Saga and Darling In The Franxx being my recent favorites. When I'm not teaching or gaming, I enjoy cycling around the city. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, around 8 PM to midnight. I'm currently single, focusing on my career and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in fine arts, which I studied in college. My gaming knowledge is pretty basic as I just started exploring it through the Nintendo Switch. Most of my learning comes from online guides and tips from friends.
